description: A blank panel 20HP wide, with no controls and no jacks, for filling a gap in the rack; the artwork is drawn in an 8-bit home-computer style
notes: the picture is not saved with the patch, so the panel returns to Base whenever the patch is loaded again
menu: Base — draws the first of the three pictures made for this width
Alternative — draws the second of the three pictures made for this width
Extreme — draws the third of the three pictures made for this width
